title: QR code generation

requirements.text: Data encodes to a valid ISO/IEC 18004 symbol (all versions and error-correction levels) that standard readers decode
The smallest fitting version and the lowest-penalty mask are chosen automatically
Data that cannot fit is refused with a clear error instead of a corrupt symbol
Output is a scalable SVG (or sized PNG) with a quiet zone of at least four modules
SVG output escapes caller text (title) and refuses unsafe color values
The rendered code has a text alternative, and the encoded link or text is also shown or available

implementations.notes: External MIT React/React Native SVG renderer
